name: Save consent
description: Records an explicit yes or no to a discovery-only profile draft. Accepted only while the interview status is created (before discovery is saved); a later call writes nothing and returns conflict true with fresh state. On an explicit yes at that stage, also returns directoryProfile (jobTitle and department, each a string or null) and directoryLookupFailure (null, or a short admin-only reason). directoryProfile is null when no lookup ran or the lookup failed.

inputFields.label: Consent granted
inputFields.description: True only if the interviewee explicitly confirmed prefill. False if they declined. Never infer from a soft or implicit reply.
